dependencyAudit.moduleInventory: Official JSZip dist has 54 Browserify modules: JSZip 1-35, Immediate 36, Lie 37, Pako 38-53, setImmediate 54.

excludedNodeDependencies.evidence: JSZip browser package maps readable-stream to its own lib/readable-stream-browser.js (module16), which exports require(stream); browser bundle map is {stream:undefined}. There is no readable-stream implementation or its buffer/stream transitive modules in the 54-module browser dist. Full PptxGenJS bundle preserves module16 as t.exports=e("stream") with {stream:void 0}. Node stream paths are not used by browser export.

dependencyAudit.additionalNotice: Pako lib/zlib sources contain a separate Zlib license notice (Gailly/Adler/Puzrin/Tupitsin); now preserved in pako-zlib-LICENSE.txt alongside Pako MIT.
